note: AcelRx May 2018 SEC Q1 cover share snapshot predates the large 2018 equity issuance and may not be carried into August positions without a corporate actions audit.

records.originalSourceDescription: AcelRx Q1 2018 10-Q cover reports 51,320,598 common shares as of May 7; prospectus dated June 27 confirms it was filed May 10. Conservative use May 11. Later Q2 cover reports 60,599,914 July 26; no assumption of unchanged capital, especially given underwritten July 2018 equity offering.
